children: CXMT is poised to benefit from vast import substitution opportunities for dynamic random access memory amid a sustained peak DRAM cycle, say UOB Kay Hian analysts in a note. The memory maker, which is China's largest for DRAM, is likely to benefit from a DRAM shortage that could last through 2028, which could keep prices elevated, they say. Meanwhile, CXMT could achieve solid progress in high bandwidth memory as rapid capacity ramp-up and yield improvements bolster production in 2026-2028, the analysts say. They expect CXMT's profit after tax to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 357.2% over 2026-2028. UOB KH starts its coverage of CXMT with a buy rating and 59.40 yuan target price. Shares last closed at 36.19 yuan. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
